messages:
Alex K: Anyone else seeing 403 when opening project console for prod-analytics? My user is in the analytics-team SCIM group. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.ai/issue/1827649301.png

Joe - Support: Can you share the exact error and your user/email + org/project id?

Alex K: Browser shows '403 Permission denied' with message 'user lacks project.viewer role'. Org: redwood-inc, project: prod-analytics. Email: alex@customer.com

Joe - Support: Thanks. Quick check — can you call GET /v1/projects/prod-analytics with your token and paste output?

Alex K: Ran: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/projects/prod-analytics` -> 403: {"error":"forbidden","reason":"role_missing","required":"project.viewer"}

Maria P: I'm seeing SCIM sync errors in the last deploy window. SCIM job logs show 500s against IdP with `invalid claim mapping`. Kicking off a manual sync now.

Elena (SRE): Heads up — IdP team rolled a claim change yesterday: group claim renamed from `groups` -> `groups_v2`. If SCIM mapping wasn't updated that would break group lookups.

Samir (Eng): If the IdP renamed the claim, the reconciler can't find the group so role propagation never happens. Workarounds: 1) assign role directly to user, or 2) update org SCIM mapping to point at the new claim and re-save to re-enqueue propagation.

Alex K: Can someone assign me temporarily? Customer is blocked and they’re in meetings this afternoon.

Joe - Support: @Samir can you apply a temporary direct role? I can also do via admin console if needed.

Samir (Eng): I can run the admin API. Sample:
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/orgs/redwood-inc/projects/prod-analytics/roles" \\
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \\
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
 -d '{"principal":"alex@customer.com","role":"project.viewer"}'
```

Joe - Support: Admin API returned 202 accepted and enqueued. Alex, can you retry the console now?

Alex K: Still 403 after retry and clearing cache. Token might be stale?

Maria P: Pulling audit logs. The last role assignment event for alex@customer.com shows source=SCIM, but there’s also an identity.provider event showing claim mismatch. Looks like the direct role request enqueued but rbac.apply failed when it tried to reconcile because the group lookup earlier errored — we’re seeing transient failures.

Elena (SRE): What did the admin API return in the body? 202 sometimes returned even if downstream rbac apply failed. If you can paste the rbac job logs that helps.

Joe - Support: Pasting audit snippet: `2026-03-15T14:05:12Z rbac.apply error: group \"analytics-team\" not found in idp for user \"alex@customer.com\"`

Maria P: Yup, SCIM re-sync currently returning 500 from IdP due to claim mapping. I see the reconciler returns 500 and doesn't mark group present.

Samir (Eng): Rolling a small patch to reconciler to fallback to `groups_v2` if `groups` empty while we get IdP team to confirm. Deploying now.

deploy-bot: scim-reconciler v1.3.2 rolled out to staging -> canary -> prod (2026-03-15T14:32:00Z).

Elena (SRE): Meanwhile quick mitigation steps for support: 
- In Console -> Org Settings -> SCIM Mappings, add a mapping for `groups_v2` and save.
- Trigger manual SCIM sync (button in UI) or run `POST /v1/admin/scim/sync?org=redwood-inc` with admin token.

Joe - Support: Done — created the `groups_v2` mapping and triggered manual sync. Also re-applied direct role for alex to be safe. Escalating to eng-infra P1 due to console block. Ticket SUP-21945 created.

Samir (Eng): Patch is live. SCIM sync retried and now IdP returns 200 for previously failing calls. I'm re-running the rbac apply for the org to ensure roles are reconciled.

Alex K: Console loads OK for me now, I can see project lists and open prod-analytics. No more 403.

Elena (SRE): Root cause = IdP claim rename without corresponding SCIM mapping update -> reconciler couldn't find groups -> role propagation failed. Fix = code fallback + org mapping change. Action items:
- Add monitoring alert for SCIM 5xx rate > 5% over 15m (Maria).
- Add end-to-end test for claim name changes in staging (Samir).
- Document the rescue flow for support (Joe).

Joe - Support: Documented workaround and resolution in SUP-21945. Closing this thread — thanks everyone :thumbsup:
